text: {"name":"configure_mmio_sync_regions","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Stores the configured MMIO base and primary register address in shared state, copies a value to the base’s offset-4 register, and sets bits 6–7 in offset-3 bytes across a register range and listed registers.","subsystem":"mmio","var_renames":{"v0":"configured_mmio_base","result":"primary_register_address","v4":"register_address","v5":"register_range_end","v6":"register_address_list","v8":"listed_register_address"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":3,"meaning":"Control byte whose bits 6–7 are set."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Register initialized with the configured value."},{"offset":2324,"meaning":"Shared-state slot storing the primary register address."},{"offset":2836,"meaning":"Shared-state slot storing the configured MMIO base."}]}
